newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Budapest bourse advances, closes at new high.
newsitem.headline: Budapest bourse advances, closes at new high.

text.p: Oil and gas company MOL took up the baton to lead the Budapest bourse index to yet another a new high on Friday while the rest of the market closed mixed, traders said.
The BUX index closed at 3,639.68 points, up 23.19, following a previous high of 3,634.80 points reached on October 7.

A wide range of blue chips joined the rising trend on Friday, but traders expected a general slowdown in price rises with only a handful of shares extending their gains substantially in the near future.
"The rising trend of one or two shares will not break but I don't expect the market to continue its spectacular rise," Robert Stalmayer of AB-Moneta Kft said.
The trader cited MOL as the main potential gainer.
"This is in connection with the energy price increase and its good assessment which is well reflected by the $100 million loan it has received," Stalmayer said.
MOL closed at 1,660 forints, up 30, but below the daily high of 1,665 forints.

Pharmaceuticals maker Richter was another potential gainer, traders said. They expected it to firm after a decline triggered by the arrival on the market this week of 517,319 new stocks after a swap of employee shares for ordinary ones.

Chemical company TVK advanced ten forints to end at 1,375 forints after the company's General Director announced on Friday he expected a pre-tax profit profit of 10 billion to 11 billion forints for 1996.
